items.context: @XRPathologist (8.127 seguidores), en inglés, siguiendo su post anterior (el que ya conversó contigo): las fases de acumulación tras el piso se acortan ~50% cada ciclo (2015: 252 días; 2018/19: 112; 2022/23: 63), así que con 30 días la expansión llegaría hacia el 21 de diciembre; mientras, rango ~$57,7K–$66K. A ~17 min: 10 likes, 2 guardados, 1 respuesta. Cuenta que ya interactúa contigo y aún no le respondes este post.
items.suggested_text:
The halving of each accumulation phase is a neat pattern, and there's a plausible mechanism behind it: the base absorbing supply keeps getting wider. Funded addresses went from roughly 1M in 2012 to 10M in 2016 and 50M in 2023, and even over the last year, with $BTC down 32%, the network added about 2.5M addresses with a balance. More holders and deeper markets should, in principle, compress the time it takes to build a base.

The caution is that it's a trend drawn through three points, and it only holds if the low is really in. Each of those phases also played out in a different market: in 2015 and 2018 there were no US spot ETFs pulling flows in and out every day.

And a shorter base doesn't automatically mean a faster trip back to the old high. That has always run on a separate clock.
